method.sourceText: Surya Siddhanta, chapter IX (Burgess and Whitney 1860)
method.eventMeaning: Twilight at which the planet is first seen or first lost, using the Siddhanta degrees-of-time limits and local horizon crossings
method.distinction: This is a classical Ujjain series. It must never be averaged with modern local-visibility or longitude-combustion series.
